g.text: Request recommended reels feed page(Cursor & session ID)
Forward feed recommendation query to Content Service
Read active feed session cache from Redis
Return cached candidate list and current cursor
Slice next page of reels andcompute next pagination cursor
Update last-seen position in session cache
Return paged feed items, next cursor, and session ID
Deliver recommended feed page to mobile viewer
Fast-path response served directly from Redis cache without database queries or ranking bottlenecks
